en.headline: Elderly foreign man dies after rescue from Western District waters
en.dek: Firefighters pulled an 80-year-old man from the sea near the China Merchants pier in Kennedy Town after a friend reported a text message about entering the water.
body: Police received a report at about 11:52 a.m. from a woman who said her approximately 80-year-old foreign male friend had sent a message indicating he would enter the sea at the Kennedy Town waterfront.

Firefighters located and rescued the man from the waters near the China Merchants Wharf on Sai Ning Street. He was unconscious and taken to Queen Mary Hospital, where he was later certified dead. Officers recovered a note at the scene.
Police are investigating the circumstances. Those experiencing distress can contact official support services including the 18111 mental health hotline.

zh.headline: 西環外籍男留短訊後蹈海 救起送院不治
zh.dek: 警方接報一名約80歲外籍男子發短訊稱在堅尼地城海傍蹈海，消防員於招商局碼頭對開救起，送院後不治。
body: 警方今早約11時52分接獲一名女子報案，指其約80歲外籍男性友人發出短訊，表示會在堅尼地城海傍入海。
消防員在西寧街招商局碼頭對開海面救起該男子，他昏迷不醒，隨即送往瑪麗醫院搶救，其後證實不治。警方在現場檢獲一封遺書。
警方正調查事件經過。有情緒困擾者可致電18111精神健康支援熱線求助。
